title: Comparative efficacy evaluation of inverted internal limiting membrane flap technique and internal limiting membrane peeling in large macular holes: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: This review included eight studies: 4 randomized control trials (RCTs) and 4 retrospective case series.
adjudication.k_quote: This review included eight studies: 4 randomized control trials (RCTs) and 4 retrospective case series.
adjudication.reason: Mixed-design review pooling RCTs and retrospective series; no RCT-only pooled synthesis is reported in the text.
